note: Majority: Age of Majority Act, Chap. 37:01 of the Laws of Dominica (Act 8 of 1983, amended by 12 of 1990; revised pages authorised 1/1991), section 3(1): a person attains full age at eighteen; section 2: an infant is a person under eighteen. Emancipation by marriage isn't held. Work: Employment of Children (Prohibition) Act, Chap. 90:05 (L.I. 5 of 1939), section 3: no one may employ a child in any occupation whatsoever, save light domestic or agricultural work at home for the parents or guardian; section 2: a child here is a person under twelve. The Employment of Women, Young Persons and Children Act, Chap. 90:06 (L.I. 5 of 1938, amended 19 of 1939; printed in the same file), sections 2 and 4: no child, there a person under fourteen, may work in an industrial undertaking (mines, manufacture, construction, transport) save a family one; a young person is one under eighteen, kept from night work. So the general age is 12, and 14 in industrial undertakings and on ships (my reading of the two Acts together). Performers: the 1939 Act bars a child under twelve from any occupation and names no exception or licence for performing, so barred (my reading). These are the 1990 revised laws; later labour legislation (and the Education Act's school age) wasn't looked for and should be checked. Service: Dominica's laws were not found to set any call-up and no defence law was read; null.

sources.title: Laws of Dominica: Age of Majority Act, Chap. 37:01
sources.said: As from the commencement of this Act a person shall attain full age on attaining the age of eighteen years

sources.title: Laws of Dominica: Employment of Children (Prohibition) Act, Chap. 90:05, and Employment of Women, Young Persons and Children Act, Chap. 90:06
sources.said: "child" means a person who in the opinion of the Court, in a prosecution for an offence against this Act, is under the age of twelve years ... "child" means a person under the age of fourteen years ... "young person" means a person who has ceased to be a child and who is under the age of eighteen years.
